blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Government Announces ₹1.25 Lakh Crore 'VB-GRAMG' Rural Development Framework. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission effective July 1, 2026.
VB-GRAMG Framework: Total allocation exceeds ₹1.25 lakh crore, covering 2.80 lakh Gram Panchayats.
MGNREGA Integration: Includes ₹30,000 crore central allocation under MGNREGA 2005.
Top State Allocations: Uttar Pradesh (₹9,721 cr), West Bengal (₹8,508 cr), Andhra Pradesh (₹7,707 cr), Tamil Nadu (₹7,585 cr).
VB-GRAMG total outlay (₹1.25 lakh crore) vs MGNREGA component (₹30,000 crore).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on 125-day wage guarantee expansion, minimum statutory wage rate (₹300/day), and replacement of MGNREGA 2005.
